items.q: Which term is described by “the flat wooden or plastic surface on which a drawing sheet is pinned and worked”?

items.q: Representative fraction may be defined as
o: the curved side surface of a cylinder or cone, excluding the ends
a view showing the object from the front or the side, giving height
a pictorial drawing in which the three axes are set at 120 degrees and true lengths are used
the ratio of a length on the drawing to the corresponding length on the object
items.s: Representative fraction: the ratio of a length on the drawing to the corresponding length on the object. The other options describe Elevation, Lateral surface, Isometric drawing.

items.q: The statement “a CAD setting that makes the cursor lock onto exact points such as endpoints and centres” describes which of the following?

items.s: Object snap is a CAD setting that makes the cursor lock onto exact points such as endpoints and centres.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Ellipse.

a line meeting another at exactly ninety degrees
a closed curve traced by a point whose distances from two fixed foci add to a constant
a projection in which the view from the left is placed on the right of the front view
items.s: Ellipse: a closed curve traced by a point whose distances from two fixed foci add to a constant. The other options describe Perpendicular, First angle projection, Drawing board.

items.q: Hatching may be defined as

items.s: Hatching: evenly spaced thin lines drawn at an angle across a cut surface in a sectional view. The other options describe Perpendicular, Isometric scale, Break line.

items.q: Bisector may be defined as

items.s: Bisector: the line or arc that divides a line or an angle into two equal parts. The other options describe Auxiliary view, Parabola, Section line.
